name: sentry-apm-getTransaction-not-etherhiding-loader
note: A bundled CLI (convex) that includes Sentry's APM ('scope.getTransaction()') and, far away in the same megafile, unrelated calldata-shaped code plus child_process. A bare '.getTransaction()' is Sentry's performance API, a DB/ORM transaction handle, and ethers' own provider.getTransaction — not an on-chain read. It now counts toward the EtherHiding onchain-c2 shape only when raw-calldata extraction sits right beside it (proximity, not same bundle). A real loader (eth_getTransactionByHash + calldata + executor) still blocks. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
